claims.text: Pre-finetuning is an additional large-scale multi-task learning stage conducted between language model pre-training and fine-tuning.
Pre-finetuning can hurt performance when a small number of tasks below a critical threshold (usually under 15) are used.
Model performance improves linearly in the number of tasks after exceeding a critical threshold of tasks (usually above 15).

evidence.description: We propose pre-finetuning, an additional largescale learning stage between language model pre-training and fine-tuning.
pre-finetuning can hurt performance when few tasks are used up until a critical point (usually above 15)
after which performance improves linearly in the number of tasks.

methodologies.name: Pre-finetuning
methodologies.description: Massively multi-task learning across around 50 datasets applied between pre-training and downstream fine-tuning.

limitations.text: Pre-finetuning degrades model performance when applied with few tasks prior to reaching a critical threshold of usually above 15 tasks.
